site_tagline: A clear path to business software
site_headline:
From an idea
to an application you can maintain.
site_description: Compose data, identity, AI, UI and delivery capabilities in TypeScript. Give people and AI shared contracts, configuration and workflows, with more time for the business itself.
site_install_note: Requires Node.js and pnpm. Confirm beta availability on npm first; see quick start for prerequisites and template choices.
site_capabilities: Connected capabilities, from creation to operation.
site_capabilities_body: Combine templates, data, security, AI, UI and delivery, with public contracts, examples and guides for each capability.
site_feature_apps_body: Generate admin, website, mobile or fullstack projects with a clear structure, development scripts, tests and shared AI guidance.
site_feature_config_body: Combine SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, caching and file storage, with documented environment overrides, actual defaults and effects.
site_feature_security_body: Connect sessions, role permissions, transport encryption and redaction. Show readable feedback first, with diagnostic IDs available on demand.
site_feature_ai_body: Use common interfaces for models, retrieval, conversation memory, tools and multimodal tasks; choose providers and persistence for your application.
site_feature_ui_body: Reuse Svelte 5 forms, tables, dialogs and scenes with shared themes, Chinese, English and Japanese, and loading, empty and failure states.
site_feature_delivery_body: Deliver full, incremental or offline releases, checking baselines, volumes and health while keeping service recovery and business data rollback distinct.
site_paths: Read for the work you need to do.
site_paths_body: Follow the steps for a first application, or go directly to configuration, operations and security guidance.
site_path_configuration_body: Sources and overrides → settings → verification → recovery
site_path_security_body: Permissions and data boundaries → failures → evidence
site_community: Improve the framework in the open.
site_community_body: Explore the implementation, report reproducible issues, or contribute to code, documentation and usability.

site_previews_title: See what the generated projects look like.
site_previews_body: Choose a starting point, then combine modules, pages and configuration. These screenshots show projects actually generated and run with the CLI.
site_previews_note: Screenshots use acceptance projects and test settings. Project names, app versions and accounts are examples. Mobile views are browser previews; open an image to see the original.
site_preview_fullstack_body: Separate service and browser applications share interface contracts. This user management view was verified after an SSH deployment.
site_preview_website_body: Start with home, about, services and contact pages, with optional static output. Connect your own service to accept contact submissions.
site_preview_admin: Admin · A business management starting point
site_preview_admin_body: Start with login, registration, a management entry point and shared components, then add business pages and access rules.
site_preview_mobile: Mobile app · A mobile business entry point
site_preview_mobile_body: Combine a mobile layout, authentication and a separate API. The image shows the generated login page in a phone-sized browser.
